correctness.rationale: The complete 2^23-state transition map was exhaustively generated and decomposed into its functional cycles with a standard in-degree deletion proof; every original state is classified with exact basin and first-periodic-entry time. A separate Euler-criterion implementation independently computes every F^t state through t=10 and verifies F^14=F^10, strict sharpness at t=9, no nontrivial period-two state, and the complete 11-row census. The affine class checker validates all 3542 canonical four-cycles, 14 full-size group classes, basin invariance and 1012 terminal states. The finite mathematical proof and independent code paths were reconstructed; no infinite inference is claimed.

value.rationale: The order-23 Paley tournament is a canonical, highly symmetric next test of whether known nineteen-vertex long oscillators persist. The result establishes a qualitative disappearance of long periods, a full fourteen-class affine orbit geometry, nine distinct basin sizes with exact multiplicities, and a sharp rare consensus tail of four affine families. These are natural dynamical invariants, exact without unproved generalization and not an arbitrary slice, routine substitution, or tiny numeric improvement.
